standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?

steps.npc: My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.

steps.player: Do you have any buckets of milk spare?

steps.npc: I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need the milk.

options.text: Can you tell me how to milk a cow?

steps.player: So how do you get milk from a cow then?

steps.npc: It's very easy. First you need an empty bucket to hold the milk.
Then find a dairy cow to milk - you can't milk just any cow.

steps.player: How do I find a dairy cow?

steps.npc: They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
There are a couple very near, in this field.
Then just milk the cow and your bucket will fill with tasty, nutritious milk.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.player: I've lost that amulet you gave me...

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.text: Gillie hands you an amulet with a bell on it.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.speaker: Gillie Groats the Milkmaid
standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.text: Tee hee! You've never milked a cow before, have you?

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.player: Erm... No. How could you tell?

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.speaker: Gillie Groats the Milkmaid
standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.text: Because you're spilling milk all over the floor. What a waste! You need something to hold the milk.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.player: Ah yes, I really should have guessed that one, shouldn't I?

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.speaker: Gillie Groats the Milkmaid
standard-dialogue-attempting-to-milk-a-d.text: You're from the city, aren't you... Try it again with an empty bucket.
